b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.full_source_subsection:
### 2.4 Payment Terms and Block Supplier

- Default Payment Terms Template: If a Payment Terms template is set here, it'll be automatically selected for future purchase transactions.

- Block Supplier: You can block invoices, payments or both from a supplier till specific date. Choose 'Hold Type', if you do not select a hold type, ERPNext will set it to "All". When a supplier is blocked, their status will be shown as 'On Hold'.

The hold types are as follows:
+ Invoices: ERPNext will not allow Purchase Invoices or Purchase Orders to be created for the supplier + Payments: ERPNext will not allow Payment Entries to be created for the Supplier + All: ERPNext will apply both hold types aboveIf you do not set a release date, ERPNext will hold the Supplier **indefinitely**.

common_adapter.notice: resource is an object; compare resource.id to organization schema resource strings. Subject id/role are neutral aliases, not an added permission rule. Source evidence and runtime path declarations contain no evaluation label.

b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.source_layer: Documentation says omitted hold type defaults to All; complete section includes the hold types and their affected operations.
b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.abi_layer: ABI declares string path only, without enum or normalization guarantee; common adapter says original trusted unchanged. Select catalog contains an empty leading option plus All, Invoices, Payments, but it is not proof of saved empty production state.
b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.production_layer: UNKNOWN whether production backend normalizes before adapter, whether empty held state is reachable, and whether adapter authenticates/freshens the state. No production vulnerability conclusion.
b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.candidate_causality: ECAS has no explicit empty-to-All normalization rule. Its restrictive allow list yields the same observed denial as the source default. This is outcome consistency, not direct proof that the model extracted default-All semantics.
b19_default_value_posthoc_clue.archived_classification_preserved: held-empty-type remains conservative_empty_type_control; no original result or branch classification modified.
